sql: select e.kind, e.severity, d.deployment_key, e.detected_at, e.resolved_at, left(coalesce(e.description,''),130) as description, left(coalesce(e.resolution,''),90) as resolution from experiment_integrity_events e left join experiment_deployments d on d.id = e.deployment_id where e.detected_at > now() - interval '40 minutes' or e.resolved_at > now() - interval '40 minutes' order by coalesce(e.resolved_at, e.detected_at) desc
